decisions.decision: Native project tracker may remain canonical with an explicit adapter; do not create a competing status database.
Protected source references substitute for copying confidential originals into a public package.
Stale map invalidates reliance on that view, not all independent authorized work.
Nondeployable artifacts use acceptance appropriate to their kind, not invented LIVE_ACCEPTED.
Track actual command argv, working directory, effects and prerequisites.
Record pending dispositions; an empty list cannot substitute for proven goals.
Do not inherit source release status, prior PASS or independent-review implications.
Do not import old generated catalogs, derived maps or mirrored guide text as new authorities.
Old SMALL/STRICT labels do not confer LITE/CONTROLLED eligibility without facts.
Historical 88/441/598 link accounting is not newly proven semantic equivalence of unavailable originals.
Source validators are not the design foundation; new schemas, tests and bounded executor implement the new contracts.
Existing comments/tests may be corrected under a legitimate change; prohibit gaming and unrelated destruction, not all edits.
